# YOLOv7-w6-face

Face Detection · `yolov7-w6-face_960x960` · DX-APP C++ example

Face Detection model, evaluated on WiderFace.

**Input** 960 × 960 × 3 · **Dataset** WiderFace · **License** GPL-3.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/face_detection/yolov7_face/yolov7-w6-face_960x960/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models YOLOv7_W6_Face
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolov7-w6-face_960x960_sync   # once
./bin/yolov7-w6-face_960x960_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolov7-w6-face_960x960.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_face.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/face_detection/yolov7_face/yolov7-w6-face_960x960/yolov7-w6-face_960x960_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolov7-w6-face_960x960.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_face.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | AP(Easy) | AP(Med) | AP(Hard) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 96.38 | 95.10 | 88.53 |
| Q-Lite | 96.45 (+0.07) | 95.16 (+0.06) | 88.70 (+0.17) |
| Q-Pro | 96.40 (+0.02) | 95.13 (+0.03) | 88.65 (+0.12) |

WiderFace · difference vs Raw in brackets.
